desc: Write complete Python program: sieve primes up to 31623; factor(n) using them (handles N ≤ 1e9 and small k, with leftover prime > 31623).
Miller-Rabin is_prime with bases {2,3,5,7,11,13,17} (valid well beyond 1e12 range needed).
Per test case: N==1 → print "2 1"; else search k=1,2,3,... until p=N*k+1 prime.
Factor p-1 via factor(N) merged with factor(k); find primitive root g (candidates 2,3,5,... checking pow(c,(p-1)//q,p)!=1 for distinct q|p-1).
Main: fast stdin read, loop over T cases, write all outputs; traced samples (N=3→(2,7), N=1→"2 1", N=16, N=55) for correctness.
